Name: Aegis Sabre Raven EX
Description:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics 
Focus: Interdiction
 
Aegis Dynamics have raised the bar yet again with their Raven variant. Nearing the speed and maneuverability of its Sabre forebearer but with a lower ship signature, the Raven is a fast, stealthy infiltrator. This special EX model reincorporates some of the offensive capabilities of the original Sabre while introducing a Quantum Dampener on the spine of the ship to help ensure enemies won't escape.
